verdict.rationale: Warp is a terminal, so shell-integrated navigation between prompts and command marks in scrollback is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence never documents jumping or navigating between prompts or command marks. Community and docs mentions of output being chunked into "Blocks" describe output segmentation and session restoration, not prompt-to-prompt navigation, so they are adjacent and earn no credit.

support.subject: As a developer, I can jump between prompts and command marks in my scrollback thanks to shell integration
